about: The photographs the Building's surfaces are made from (crates/game/assets/textures/, by build.py). Every one is CC0. The Commons files are checked by the SHA-1 Commons publishes; the Panelka files by the SHA-1 of each file in the pack's zip. pictures.about: The pictures the rooms' framed photographs, paintings, maps, plates and prints show (crates/game/assets/textures/pictures.jpg, one atlas, by build.py's pictures()): old photographs of anonymous sitters (before 1930), paintings, maps and botanical and anatomical plates of the Rijksmuseum and the Cleveland Museum of Art, each released by the museum as CC0 1.0 and fetched from Wikimedia Commons, checked by the SHA-1 Commons publishes. Each is cropped (`crop`: x0, y0, x1, y1 of the original, as fractions; narrowed to its cell's shape about the crop's middle, or with `pad` fitted whole and set on its own paper) and laid in its cell of the atlas (`cell`: x, y, w, h in px); `same_as` cuts it from another picture's file. Nothing is graded here: the game fades, yellows, silvers or cracks each print as it paints it (visuals::pictures).
